from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "A basis is our space's minimalist toolkit.",
            "It must span the space and be independent.",
            "No waste, yet complete coverage of every point.",
            "Like unit vectors, they define our coordinate system.",
            "A basis is the DNA of any vector space."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Basis: The Efficient Blueprint", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        color_i = "#F0E68C"
        color_j = "#E6E6FA"
        color_white = "#FFFFFF"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(color_white)
        
        # Create a local coordinate system in the right area
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY_B}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B1", "E6")
        
        vector_i = Vector([1, 0], color=color_i).shift(axes.c2p(0,0))
        vector_j = Vector([0, 1], color=color_j).shift(axes.c2p(0,0))
        
        label_i = MathTex(r"\hat{i}", color=color_i).next_to(vector_i, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        label_j = MathTex(r"\hat{j}", color=color_j).next_to(vector_j, LEFT, buff=0.1)

        self.play(Create(axes), FadeIn(vector_i), FadeIn(vector_j), Write(label_i), Write(label_j))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(color_white)
        
        # Independent: they don't lie on the same line. 
        # Redundancy check: show they can't be made from each other.
        self.play(Indicate(vector_i), Indicate(vector_j))
        self.play(Flash(vector_i, color=color_i), Flash(vector_j, color=color_j))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(color_white)
        
        # Show spanning: reaching (1.5, 1.2)
        target_point = axes.c2p(1.5, 1.2)
        dot = Dot(target_point, color=color_white)
        
        scaled_i = Vector([1.5, 0], color=color_i).shift(axes.c2p(0,0))
        scaled_j = Vector([0, 1.2], color=color_j).shift(axes.c2p(1.5,0))
        
        self.play(Create(dot))
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(vector_i.copy(), scaled_i),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(vector_j.copy(), scaled_j),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        combo_text = MathTex("1.5\\hat{i} + 1.2\\hat{j}", color=color_white, font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(combo_text, "A4")
        self.play(Write(combo_text))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(color_white)
        
        # Show a grid emerging from these vectors
        grid_lines = axes.get_grid_lines(color=BLUE_E, line_func=Line)
        self.play(Create(grid_lines), FadeOut(combo_text), FadeOut(dot), FadeOut(scaled_i), FadeOut(scaled_j))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(color_white)
        
        # Conceptual "DNA" flash
        self.play(Indicate(self.title))
        self.play(axes.animate.set_color(WHITE), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
